verdict.rationale: Vercel documents built-in monitoring for traffic, function performance, and errors within its own platform (vercel-docs-30) and marketplace integrations like Better Stack for logging, but there's no evidence of a custom dashboard-building capability that lets a devops-lead combine metrics from arbitrary/any external services into unified views — Vercel's observability is scoped to its own deployments and AI workflows, not a general-purpose dashboard tool.
